<!--
Note for AI-generated or AI-assisted PRs: this description will be read by a human,
not by another model. Keep it short when possible using your best criteria.

Do:
- Explain the "why": the motivation, the bug scenario, the reasoning behind
  non-obvious decisions.

Don't:
- Re-narrate the code change step by step, or restate what a diff already shows
  (import changes, renamed functions, "extracted X into a helper", etc).
- Add an "Approach" section or similar that walks through the implementation line by line.
- Include a validation/testing log — maintainers know how to validate a change,
  they don't need a transcript of every command run.
- Pad the description to look thorough. Longer is not more trustworthy.
-->

## Description

<!-- Why is this change needed? What problem does it solve or what motivates the improvement? -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title clearly describes the change
- [ ] The description explains the *why*, not the *what* (that's already visible in the code)
- [ ] I have added or updated tests covering the change (if applicable)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (if applicable)
- [ ] I have tested the changes locally / on a test cluster
- [ ] The changes do not break backward compatibility (or it's called out and justified if they do)
- [ ] I have checked that no credentials, tokens, or sensitive data are included

## Related issues

<!-- e.g. Closes #123, Relates to #456 -->
